$comment: Every transformation applied to the source is declared here. verify.py treats anything removed that is NOT matched by a drop rule as a failure, so this file is the complete, auditable list of what the pipeline takes out.

drop_rules.reason: The printed folio number is page furniture, not content. It is removed structurally at the first line of each page and preserved as the <!-- p. N --> anchor. Scope matters: applied to every line this pattern would also delete table cells such as '37'.

verbatim_reason: Pages whose layout is tabular or multi-column (table_density > 0.40). Emitted as fenced verbatim blocks rather than reflowed into Markdown tables: token equality cannot prove a number is still in the right row, and reflowing is where silent corruption hides.
